verdict.rationale: The evidence shows TrueLayer authenticates with client credentials, bearer tokens and ECDSA signing keys, and offers an MCP server for Claude. Nothing documents issuing scoped, restricted or least-privilege credentials for an agent. The Console user-invite feature governs which team members can retrieve credentials, which is an adjacent control and not credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
